title: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime', show the per-displ
question: For instance display names matching the pattern 'prime', show the per-display-name instance count, average memory (MB), and memory variance (MB) (including the TOTAL rollup row), and for those same display names list the system metadata rows for non-deleted instances on host 'blaze8-12' whose memory is above the average memory of all non-deleted instances on that host, including instance UUID, VM state, metadata key/value, and the rank of each metadata row within its key group. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH prime_instances AS (
    SELECT uuid, display_name, memory_mb
    FROM instances
    WHERE display_name LIKE '%prime%'
),
host_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory
    FROM instances
    WHERE host = 'blaze8-12' AND deleted = 0
),
metadata_rows AS (
    SELECT 
        i.display_name,
        i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
        i.vm_state,
        ism.`key` AS metadata_key,
        ism.`value` AS metadata_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`key` ORDER BY ism.`value`) AS metadata_rank
    FROM instances i
    JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
    CROSS JOIN host_avg ha
    WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
      AND i.deleted = 0
      AND i.memory_mb > ha.avg_memory
      AND i.display_name LIKE '%prime%'
),
stats AS (
    SELECT 
        display_name,
        COUNT(*) AS instance_count,
        AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb,
        VARIANCE(memory_mb) AS memory_variance_mb
    FROM prime_instances
    GROUP BY display_name
)
SELECT 
    s.display_name,
    s.instance_count,
    s.avg_memory_mb,
    s.memory_variance_mb,
    m.instance_uuid,
    m.vm_state,
    m.metadata_key,
    m.metadata_value,
    m.metadata_rank
FROM stats s
LEFT JOIN metadata_rows m ON s.display_name = m.display_name
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'TOTAL' AS display_name,
    SUM(instance_count) AS instance_count,
    AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb,
    AVG(memory_variance_mb) AS memory_variance_mb,
    NULL AS instance_uuid,
    NULL AS vm_state,
    NULL AS metadata_key,
    NULL AS metadata_value,
    NULL AS metadata_rank
FROM stats
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN display_name = 'TOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    display_name,
    metadata_rank
